result.summary: The page renders mostly cleanly; the only visible defect is a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card, indicating a content/styling bug in the discount label logic.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section displays '-0%', which is nonsensical and suggests the discount percentage is not being computed or is zero while the badge is still rendered.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0% (or below a meaningful threshold), and fix the logic so the badge only appears with a valid positive discount value.
